title: [P3-04] Reconcile PR ownership, merge sequence, and dependency configuration
body:
<!-- issue-734-triage:v1:start -->
## Reviewed backlog triage — #734

- Disposition: **implement**. Retain the contributor tooling and experiments acceptance as ordered implementation/integration work in Phase 3; source presence alone does not prove its acceptance.
- Accountable ledger owner: **dhar174**; existing assignees preserved.
- Canonical topic: #14 (Contributor tooling and experiments); existing native parent preserved.
- Order: Phase 3; native prerequisites #736, #735. Proposed execution prerequisites #732; handoff #737 (coordination, not an additional blocker).
- Acceptance/reproduction: Assign a reviewer and owner to each selected implementation PR and verify current CI/mergeability.; Rebase each dependent PR after its prerequisite lands; retain existing native parents and dependency links.; Update Phase/Sequence/Readiness/Depends on and create a distinct issue for every newly discovered remediation.
- Evidence: #734's reviewed ledger and retained snapshot at `13b8e374d07e7e7ea6f8f562ea6a290fcab967f7`; outcome `existing_roadmap_or_remediation_acceptance_preserved`. Unexecuted behavior is not verified.
- Closure and gate boundary: No later human gate or broader product readiness is inferred.

- Publication approved under [D027](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/blob/eb3f1e2/docs/decisions.md#d027--approve-and-publish-the-734-backlog-triage-package); preserved source evidence remains scoped as above.

<!-- issue-734-triage:v1:end -->

## Ordered delivery task P3-04

Maintain the issue-backed Project as the live execution plan after backlog triage.

- Phase: 3 - Consolidate backlog and pull requests
- Sequence: 3004
- Priority: P1
- Scope: MVP
- Workstream: Planning
- Kind: Task
- Parent phase: [E3](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/733)

### Prerequisites

- [P3-01](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/734)
- [P3-02](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/735)
- [P3-03](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/736)
- [H2](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/732)

The preceding phase gate must be human-approved. Dependency closure alone does not supply a human decision.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Assign a reviewer and owner to each selected implementation PR and verify current CI/mergeability.
- [ ] Rebase each dependent PR after its prerequisite lands; retain existing native parents and dependency links.
- [ ] Update Phase/Sequence/Readiness/Depends on and create a distinct issue for every newly discovered remediation.

### Evidence to retain

Current commit/PR SHA; exact commands and executed result counts; relevant state traces/screens; review artifacts; limitations; linked follow-up issues.

<!-- tiny-village-roadmap:v1:P3-04:end -->
